name: test-qa-suite
description: A single, coherent test suite spanning the four layers a senior QA/SDET role actually touches — UI, API, performance, and data — wired together with CI/CD. Built as a portfolio project against public demo targets: [saucedemo.com](https://www.saucedemo.com) (UI) and [fakestoreapi.com](https://fakestoreapi.com) (API/performance).
